narrative.overview: The Pudugai Wellness Center design language conveys gentle, grounded health guidance rooted in community trust. Rather than adopting the cold, sterile clinical whites of a diagnostic hospital or the neon-infused aggressive gradients of a commercial fitness gym, PWC feels warm, organic, and approachable. Deep forest green anchors the identity, paired with warm off-white surfaces, generous breathing room, and crisp typography with native Tamil script fallbacks.
keyCharacteristics: Organic Restraint: Dominant dark green brand voice with neutral off-white surfaces; zero gratuitous animations or sensory overload.
Human-Scale Density: Generous line heights (1.65–1.75) and spacious card padding (1.5rem–2.5rem) that welcome older adults and families.
Frictionless Action: Primary actions lead directly to authentic communication channels (clickable tel: links, WhatsApp chats with prefilled messages, and Google Maps location buttons).

rules.name: The Forest Anchor Rule
rules.body: The dark green primary (#134e32) and deepest green (#0d3824) are reserved for brand signifiers, titles, and key CTAs. Backgrounds remain light (#ffffff or #f8faf8) to maintain high legibility and openness.

rules.name: The WhatsApp Distinctiveness Rule
rules.body: #15803d is exclusively reserved for WhatsApp actions and genuine success indicators. It is never used for general decorative borders.

rules.name: The High Contrast Body Rule
rules.body: Body text never uses washed-out grays. Text defaults to dark charcoal (#374151) on light backgrounds, exceeding WCAG 2.1 AA requirements.

rules.name: The iOS Input Rule
rules.body: Form inputs and selects strictly enforce font-size: 16px minimum to prevent mobile Safari auto-zooming the viewport upon focus.

rules.name: The Tinted Ambient Rule
rules.body: Shadows are never neutral black (rgba(0,0,0,...)). They incorporate brand forest green (rgba(19, 78, 50, ...)) to harmonize with the organic canvas.

dos: Do use var(--color-primary) (#134e32) or var(--color-primary-dark) (#0d3824) for prominent headlines and primary buttons.
Do enforce a minimum touch target of 44px on all clickable interactive elements.
Do maintain bilingual cultural compatibility (Tamil text fallbacks and Tamil language badges on success stories).
Do include clear, prominent medical disclaimers on all pages discussing body composition or weight loss.
Do ensure phone numbers are clickable tel: links and WhatsApp links use prefilled messages.
donts: Don't use black drop shadows; always use forest-green tinted shadows (rgba(19, 78, 50, ...)).
Don't use input font sizes smaller than 16px, which trigger automatic iOS viewport zoom.
Don't make clinical diagnoses or medical promises; keep tone educational, supportive, and non-prescriptive.
Don't introduce heavy gradients, floating neon accents, or aggressive commercial gym aesthetics.
Don't create separate desktop and mobile button links with conflicting destinations.
